+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/adversarial-review-budget.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.3 (PRD FR-7 AC-7.5, SDD D-7.4, D-7.6).
+#
+# The dissent budget pre-check prices every planned voice — the primary, the companion's first hop, each advisory voice —
+# at its catalog price (python3 -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias), instead of the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok.
+# An alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 for that voice and is said by name; a zero-priced entry estimates
+# zero and is said too. Prices come from fixture entries in the test's project config (hounfour.providers overlays the
+# catalog, as cheval merges it). Each voice: input tokens × input rate + 2000 × output rate, micro-USD/Mtok → cents.
+# =============================================================================
+
+load adversarial-review-s3-helpers
+
+setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3bud; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
+teardown() { s3_teardown; }
+
+_cfg() {  # <model> <budget> <companion_voice> [extra code_review lines]
+    s3_config "hounfour:
+  providers:
+    openai:
+      models:
+        fixture-priced:
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 2000000, output_per_mtok: 8000000}
+    fixturelocal:
+      models:
+        fixture-zero:
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
+        fixture-stale:
+          price_date: \"2000-01-01\"
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 1000000, output_per_mtok: 1000000}
+flatline_protocol:
+  code_review:
+    enabled: true
+    model: $1
+    budget_cents: $2
+    timeout_seconds: 30
+    companion_voice: $3
+    fallback_chain: []
+${4:-}"
+}
+
+_big_diff() {  # a diff whose estimate is 1,000,500 input tokens (3,000,000 bytes / 3 + 500)
+    { printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n'; head -c $(( 3000000 - 25 )) /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'a'; } > "$T/diff.patch"
+    [ "$(wc -c < "$T/diff.patch")" -eq 3000000 ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-1 the primary is priced at its catalog rate (no fixed-rate fallback): 1,000,500 tokens × 2 + 2000 × 8 USD/Mtok = 201c" {
+    _big_diff
+    _cfg fixture-priced 150 false
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "budget_exceeded" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "201" ]
+    [ "$(jq -c '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | {role, alias, estimated_cents, pricing_source}]' <<<"$result")" = '[{"role":"primary","alias":"fixture-priced","estimated_cents":201,"pricing_source":"config"}]' ]
+    grep -qF "budget: estimate 201c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-priced 201c)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    ! grep -q "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log" || { echo "a catalog-priced primary fell back"; return 1; }
+    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-2 an alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok for that voice, said by name (1000c + 6c)" {
+    _big_diff
+    _cfg mystery-model-x 150 false
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.estimate_voices[0].pricing_source' <<<"$result")" = "fallback" ]
+    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (primary) — the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok applies to this voice" "$T/stderr.log"
+    [ "$(grep -c "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log")" = "1" ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-3 a zero-priced entry estimates 0c and is said: a 0-cent budget admits it, where the fixed rate would refuse" {
+    _cfg fixture-zero 0 false
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (primary) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qF "budget: estimate 0c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-zero 0c)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qx "fixture-zero" "$CALLS"
+    # the same run priced at the fixed rate is refused (the regression this replaces: 2000 output tokens × 30 = 6c > 0)
+    _cfg mystery-model-x 0 false
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-4 the gate sums every planned voice: primary + the companion's first hop + each advisory voice" {
+    _big_diff
+    _cfg fixture-priced 1 true "    advisory_voices: [fixture-zero, mystery-model-x]"
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | "\(.role)=\(.alias)"] | join(" ")' <<<"$result")" = "primary=fixture-priced companion=claude-headless advisory=fixture-zero advisory=mystery-model-x" ]
+    # the companion's price is the catalog's (whatever it is today): recompute it from the same CLI
+    local row ci co comp
+    row=$(PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters" python3 -W ignore::RuntimeWarning -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias claude-headless --config "$CONFIG_FILE")
+    ci=$(sed -n 's/.* input_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row"); co=$(sed -n 's/.* output_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row")
+    [[ "$ci" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$co" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
+    comp=$(( 1000500 * ci / 10000000000 + 2000 * co / 10000000000 ))
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[1].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$comp" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[2].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "0" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[3].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$(( 201 + comp + 0 + 1006 ))" ]
+    [ "$(jq '[.metadata.estimate_voices[].estimated_cents] | add' <<<"$result")" = "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" ]
+    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (advisory) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (advisory)" "$T/stderr.log"
+}
+
+@test "BUD-5 a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) is used as given and said" {
+    _cfg fixture-stale 1000 false
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    grep -qF "budget: fixture-stale (primary) has a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) — used as given" "$T/stderr.log"
+}
+
+@test "BUD-6 with no price CLI answer at all every voice falls back and is said (the gate never prices from nothing)" {
+    _cfg fixture-priced 1000 false
+    # a PYTHONPATH that cannot import the package: the CLI fails, every planned voice is unknown
+    local real patched
+    real="$(declare -f _adv_budget_estimate)"
+    patched="${real/PYTHONPATH=\"\$PROJECT_ROOT\/.claude\/adapters\"/PYTHONPATH=/nonexistent}"
+    [ "$patched" != "$real" ]   # (the seam was found: the CLI really cannot be imported in this run)
+    eval "$patched"
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ]
+    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for fixture-priced (primary)" "$T/stderr.log"
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/adversarial-review-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1 … AC-8.3, SDD D-8.0 … D-8.2,
+# DEC-0146).
+#
+# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, adversarial-review.sh plans only hops whose provider has dispatch_group: local in
+# the merged config (catalog + the project's hounfour.providers) and refuses every hosted hop of its inventory at plan time
+# by name — primary chain, companion chain, advisory voices, the KF-004 repair chain (tiny, claude-headless, any pin; the
+# chain is the answering voice). With one local family the audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW, the gate and verdict-derive
+# treat the envelope as today, and the output says so. The default (hosted) is unchanged. Mock mode: the harness stub.
+# =============================================================================
+
+load adversarial-review-s3-helpers
+
+setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3loc; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
+teardown() { s3_teardown; }
+
+# one hosted provider (openai, the catalog's) and one local provider (localbox, declared here)
+_cfg() {  # <locality value | absent> [extra code_review / security_audit lines]
+    local loc=""; [[ "$1" == absent ]] || loc="  locality: $1"
+    s3_config "hounfour:
+$loc
+  providers:
+    localbox:
+      type: openai_compat
+      endpoint: \"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1\"
+      models:
+        qwen-local:
+          dispatch_group: local
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
+        qwen-local-b:
+          dispatch_group: local
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
+        qwen-local-c:
+          dispatch_group: local
+        qwen-leaky:
+          dispatch_group: local
+          fallback_chain: [\"openai:gpt-5.5\"]
+  aliases:
+    lq: \"localbox:qwen-local\"
+    lqb: \"localbox:qwen-local-b\"
+    lqc: \"localbox:qwen-local-c\"
+flatline_protocol:
+  code_review:
+    enabled: true
+    model: gpt-5.5
+    budget_cents: 500
+    timeout_seconds: 30
+    fallback_chain: [lq]
+${2:-}
+  security_audit:
+    enabled: true
+    model: gpt-5.5
+    budget_cents: 500
+    timeout_seconds: 30
+    fallback_chain: [lq]
+${3:-}"
+}
+
+_hosted_in() {  # <file of hop names, one per line> → the hosted ones, as hop-locality.py classifies them against this config
+    local hops; hops=$(sed 's/^repair://' "$1" | sort -u | grep -v '^$' || true)
+    [[ -n "$hops" ]] || return 0
+    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+    python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
+        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- $hops | awk -F'\t' '$3 != "local" { print $1 }'
+}
+
+@test "LOC-1 one hosted and one local provider: only the local hop is planned and every hosted hop is refused by name" {
+    _cfg local_voices
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
+    # the dispatched hops: the local one only
+    [ "$(sort -u "$CALLS" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "lq " ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.final_model' "$env")" = "lq" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.model_attempts | join(",")' "$env")" = "lq:reviewed" ]
+    # each refusal named: the hosted primary, the companion's default hop, the repair chain's two hosted hops
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5 (openai)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop claude-headless (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop tiny (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    # the companion was not planned: its chain had no local hop — never rerouted
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.planned' "$env")" = "false" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.reason' "$env")" = "locality_refused" ]
+    # the envelope names the posture and each refusal with its role
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.locality.mode' "$env")" = "local_voices" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.locality.refused[] | "\(.role):\(.alias):\(.provider)"] | sort | join(" ")' "$env")" = \
+      "companion:claude-headless:anthropic primary:gpt-5.5:openai repair:claude-headless:anthropic repair:tiny:anthropic" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "1" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-2 the repair chain is pinned to the answering local voice: no tiny, no claude-headless, no pin — even with an Anthropic key" {
+    _cfg local_voices
+    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key"   # (tiny would lead the hosted chain with a key present)
+    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL="tiny claude-headless"
+    load_adversarial_config review
+    [ "$CONF_LOCALITY" = "local_voices" ]
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "lq" ]
+    [ "$(_repair_chain_base lq)" = "lq" ]
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain gpt-5.5)" = "" ]   # (a hosted answering voice gets no repair hop at all)
+    # and under hosted the same host walks tiny first (the switch is what pins it)
+    _cfg hosted
+    load_adversarial_config review
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "tiny claude-headless" ]   # (the operator pin is the whole chain under hosted)
+    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "tiny claude-headless lq" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-3 redaction-style: in a whole run with a rejected payload, an Anthropic key and the CLIs present, no hosted alias is ever dispatched" {
+    _cfg local_voices "    advisory_voices: [lqc, gpt-5.5-pro]
+    companion_chain:
+      anthropic: [opus, lqb]"
+    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key" OPENAI_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key"
+    _repair_finding_via_model() { echo "repair:$4" >> "$CALLS"; return 1; }
+    BEHAVIOUR[lq]=reject
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
+    [ -s "$CALLS" ]
+    grep -qx "repair:lq" "$CALLS"   # (the repair loop ran — pinned to the answering voice)
+    [ "$(_hosted_in "$CALLS")" = "" ] || { echo "hosted hops dispatched:"; _hosted_in "$CALLS"; return 1; }
+    # no hosted name in any planned hop the envelope records
+    local planned
+    planned=$(jq -r '[.metadata.model_attempts[], (.metadata.companion_voice.chain // [])[], (.advisory_voices // [] | map(select(.status != "refused")) | .[].alias)] | .[] | sub(":[a-z_]+$"; "")' "$env")
+    printf '%s\n' "$planned" > "$T/planned"
+    [ "$(_hosted_in "$T/planned")" = "" ] || { echo "hosted hops planned:"; _hosted_in "$T/planned"; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.chain | join(",")' "$env")" = "lqb" ]
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop opus (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5-pro (openai)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    # the refused advisory voice is named in the block, never run
+    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[] | select(.alias == "gpt-5.5-pro") | .status' "$env")" = "refused" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[] | select(.alias == "lqc") | .status' "$env")" = "succeeded" ]
+    ! grep -qx "gpt-5.5-pro" "$CALLS" || { echo "a refused advisory voice was dispatched"; return 1; }
+}
+
+@test "LOC-4 one local family on the audit gate: the companion is duplicate_voice, the DEGRADED sentence is in the output, and the gate and verdict-derive treat the envelope as today" {
+    _cfg local_voices "" "    companion_chain:
+      anthropic: [lqb]"
+    s3_run audit >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-audit.json"
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.counted_as' "$env")" = "duplicate_voice" ]
+    local s="locality: local_voices — with one local family the companion is not an independent second voice (duplicate_voice, or not planned), so every security audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW; adversarial-review-gate.sh and verdict-derive.sh treat this envelope exactly as they treat any other."
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] $s" "$T/stderr.log"
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.locality.note' "$env")" = "$s" ]
+    # the config comment carries the same sentence
+    grep -qF "$s" "$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml.example"
+    # the COMPLETED gate opens on it (presence + metadata.type/model — today's check)
+    local hook="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/adversarial-review-gate.sh" cfg="$T/gate.yaml" rc=0
+    printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$cfg"
+    printf '{"tool_name":"Write","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s/COMPLETED"}}' "$OUT_DIR" \
+        | env -u LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE LOA_CONFIG_PATH_OVERRIDE="$cfg" bash "$hook" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rc=$?
+    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]
+    # verdict-derive reads it like any envelope: an approved audit with the DEGRADED marker is consistent
+    printf '%s\n' "APPROVED - LET'S FUCKING GO" '' 'DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW: one local family (locality: local_voices).' \
+        '<!-- LOA-VERDICT {"gate":"audit","verdict":"APPROVED","counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":0,"low":0},"sprint_id":"sprint-x","ts":"2026-10-14T00:00:00Z"} -->' \
+        > "$OUT_DIR/auditor-sprint-feedback.md"
+    run bash "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh" --file "$OUT_DIR/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" --gate audit --json
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.consistent' <<<"$output")" = "true" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.verdict' <<<"$output")" = "APPROVED" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-5 the default (no key) and hounfour.locality: hosted are unchanged: the hosted primary is dispatched, nothing is refused, no locality key" {
+    local v
+    for v in absent hosted; do
+        : > "$CALLS"
+        _cfg "$v"
+        s3_run review >/dev/null
+        [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+        grep -qx "gpt-5.5" "$CALLS"
+        grep -qx "claude-headless" "$CALLS"   # (the default companion chain on a keyless host with the CLI)
+        ! grep -q "locality:" "$T/stderr.log" || { echo "a locality line under $v"; return 1; }
+        jq -e '.metadata | has("locality") | not' "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json" >/dev/null
+        [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json")" = "2" ]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "LOC-6 a primary chain with no local hop is refused before any call; an unknown locality value is refused by name" {
+    _cfg local_voices
+    yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.fallback_chain = ["gpt-5.3-codex"]' "$CONFIG_FILE"
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "1" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "locality_refused" ]
+    grep -qF "locality: local_voices leaves no local hop on the primary chain" "$T/stderr.log"
+    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
+    _cfg local
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "1" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "locality_invalid" ]
+    grep -qF "hounfour.locality='local' is neither hosted nor local_voices" "$T/stderr.log"
+    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-7 a local entry whose fallback_chain reaches a hosted model is hosted (cheval would walk it inside the call)" {
+    _cfg local_voices
+    run python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
+        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- lq localbox:qwen-leaky opus native unknown-x
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$(sed -n 1p <<<"$output" | cut -f2-3)" = "localbox	local" ]
+    [ "$(sed -n 2p <<<"$output" | cut -f3-4)" = "hosted	fallback_chain_reaches_hosted:openai:gpt-5.5(openai)" ]
+    [ "$(sed -n 3p <<<"$output" | cut -f2-3)" = "anthropic	hosted" ]
+    [ "$(sed -n 4p <<<"$output" | cut -f3)" = "hosted" ]
+    [ "$(sed -n 5p <<<"$output" | cut -f2-4)" = "unknown	hosted	unresolved" ]
+    # an unreadable config is fail-closed: every hop hosted
+    printf ':\n  - [\n' > "$T/broken.yaml"
+    run python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" --config "$T/broken.yaml" -- lq
+    [ "$(cut -f3-4 <<<"${lines[-1]}")" = "hosted	config_unreadable" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-8 the multi-model reference says the Claude Code session model is exempt and remains the platform" {
+    grep -q "hounfour.locality: local_voices" "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/loa/reference/multi-model-reference.md"
+    grep -qi "Claude Code session model is exempt" "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/loa/reference/multi-model-reference.md"
+}

+    export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$T/model-invoke.jsonl"
+    export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$T/cost-ledger.jsonl"
+    export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$T" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$T/xdg-cache"
+    export TMPDIR="$T/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
+    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_KEEP_WORKDIR LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_TAG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE \
+          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REAP_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_MODEL_CONFIG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_HOP_TIMEOUT \
+          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
+          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
+    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
+    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
+    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
+    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
+    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
+    eval "$_src"
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
+    local p v; local -a row
+    for p in anthropic openai google; do read -ra row <<<"$(_adv_cred_aliases "$p")"; for v in "${row[@]}"; do unset "$v"; done; done
+    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR="$T/env"; mkdir -p "$LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR"
+    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi
+    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_PROBE=both
+    CONFIG_FILE="$T/loa.config.yaml"
+    printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n--- a/x.sh\n+++ b/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n' > "$T/diff.patch"
+    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
+    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
+    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
+    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
+    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]

+            ok)
+                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"

+                  '{content: ({findings: [{id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:10",
+                     description: ("from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
+                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.0123, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
+                return 0 ;;
+            two)   # one finding that matches the counted one (same file, overlapping lines, same category), one on another line,
+                   # one on the same line in another category
+                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
+                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" '{content: ({findings: [
+                    {id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:9-12", description: ("dup from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
+                    {id: "DISS-002", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:40", description: ("new from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
+                    {id: "DISS-003", severity: $s, category: "performance", anchor: "x.sh:10", description: ("other category from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
+                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.002, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
+                return 0 ;;
+            reject)   # a payload the normaliser cannot save (no severity)
+                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
+                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
+                return 0 ;;
+            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
+            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;

+            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
+        esac
+    }
+    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
+        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
+            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
+        else
+            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
+        fi
+    }

+s3_teardown() {

+    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
+    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
+    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
+    return 0
+}
+
+s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
+    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
+}
+
+s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
+    local rc=0
+    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
+    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
+}
+
+s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
+    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
+    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.4 (SDD D-7.7, DEC-0150): Bridgebuilder exits 3 when a multi-model review COMPLETED with a
+# DEGRADED consensus. Every shell caller that tests the exit code treats 3 as "completed, degraded": one WARN line naming
+# the incomplete voices, never a failure. A stub Bridgebuilder entry.sh stands in for the real one.
+
+setup() {
+    BATS_TEST_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/bb-exit-degraded.XXXXXX")"
+    STUB="$WORK/stub-entry.sh"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    [[ -n "${WORK:-}" && -d "$WORK" ]] && rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# make_stub <exit_code>: a stub entry.sh that prints a run JSON naming one incomplete voice, then exits <exit_code>
+make_stub() {
+    cat > "$STUB" <<'STUB_EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+echo '{"mode":"multi-model","degraded":true,"verdicts":[{"pr":7,"voices":{"planned":2,"completed":1,"incomplete":["openai/gpt-5.5"]}}]}'
+STUB_EOF
+    echo "exit $1" >> "$STUB"
+    chmod +x "$STUB"
+}
+
+# --- session-cap-bb dispatcher.sh ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+run_dispatcher() {
+    local cid="cyc-$1"
+    local handoff="$WORK/tmp/loa-session-cap-bb.$cid"
+    mkdir -p "$handoff"
+    printf '{"action":"dispatch"}' > "$handoff/decider.json"
+    DISPATCHER_JSON="$handoff/dispatcher.json"
+    run env TMPDIR="$WORK/tmp" LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_ENTRY="$STUB" LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_REPO="fixture/repo" \
+        bash "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills/scheduled-cycle-template/contracts/session-cap-bb/dispatcher.sh" "$cid" sched-1 0 '[]'
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: Bridgebuilder exit 3 is completed-degraded — WARN names the voice, handoff degraded, exit 0" {
+    make_stub 3
+    run_dispatcher a
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: bridgebuilder completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5"* ]]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.bb_exit_code' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "3" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "true" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.incomplete_voices' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "openai/gpt-5.5" ]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: Bridgebuilder's run JSON still reaches stdout" {
+    make_stub 3
+    run_dispatcher b
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *'"mode":"multi-model"'* ]]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: exit 0 stays 0 with degraded false and no WARN" {
+    make_stub 0
+    run_dispatcher c
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"DEGRADED"* ]]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r 'has("incomplete_voices")' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: any other non-zero exit is still a failure" {
+    make_stub 1
+    run_dispatcher d
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.bb_exit_code' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "1" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+# --- spiral-harness.sh _gate_bridgebuilder ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# run_gate <exit_code>: source the harness, point it at a fake skills tree holding the stub, run the gate
+run_gate() {
+    make_stub "$1"
+    mkdir -p "$WORK/fake/scripts" "$WORK/fake/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources" "$WORK/evidence"
+    cp "$STUB" "$WORK/fake/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh"
+    run bash -c '
+        cd "$1" || exit 99
+        source "$2/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh"
+        set +e
+        SCRIPT_DIR="$1/fake/scripts"
+        EVIDENCE_DIR="$1/evidence"
+        _record_action() { echo "RECORDED:$1:${10}"; }
+        _gate_bridgebuilder "https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/7"
+        echo "GATE_RC=$?"
+    ' _ "$WORK" "$PROJECT_ROOT"
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: Bridgebuilder exit 3 logs one WARN naming the voice and the gate passes" {
+    run_gate 3
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: Bridgebuilder review iter 1 completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"RECORDED:GATE_BRIDGEBUILDER:posted"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+    [ "$(grep -c 'DEGRADED' <<<"$output")" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: exit 0 logs no WARN" {
+    run_gate 0
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN: Bridgebuilder"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: another non-zero exit is logged as not completed (non-blocking, as before)" {
+    run_gate 1
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: Bridgebuilder review iter 1 exited 1 (the review did not complete)"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness: every entry.sh invocation goes through _bb_surface_exit (no bare || true)" {
+    local script="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh"
+    local invocations surfaced
+    invocations=$(grep -c '"\$entry_script" --pr' "$script")
+    surfaced=$(grep -c '_bb_surface_exit "\$bb_rc"' "$script")
+    [ "$invocations" -ge 2 ]
+    [ "$invocations" -eq "$surfaced" ]
+}
+
+@test "entry.sh: the missing-dependency preflight exits 4, never the DEGRADED code 3" {
+    local entry="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh"
+    run grep -n '^  exit 3$' "$entry"
+    [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+    run grep -c '^  exit 4$' "$entry"
+    [ "$output" = "1" ]
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.4 (SDD D-7.7, DEC-0150): Bridgebuilder exits 3 when a multi-model review COMPLETED with a
+# DEGRADED consensus. Every shell caller that tests the exit code treats 3 as "completed, degraded": one WARN line naming
+# the incomplete voices, never a failure. A stub Bridgebuilder entry.sh stands in for the real one.
+
+setup() {
+    BATS_TEST_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+    WORK="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/bb-exit-degraded.XXXXXX")"
+    STUB="$WORK/stub-entry.sh"
+}
+
+teardown() {
+    [[ -n "${WORK:-}" && -d "$WORK" ]] && rm -rf "$WORK"
+}
+
+# make_stub <exit_code>: a stub entry.sh that prints a run JSON naming one incomplete voice, then exits <exit_code>
+make_stub() {
+    cat > "$STUB" <<'STUB_EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+echo '{"mode":"multi-model","degraded":true,"verdicts":[{"pr":7,"voices":{"planned":2,"completed":1,"incomplete":["openai/gpt-5.5"]}}]}'
+STUB_EOF
+    echo "exit $1" >> "$STUB"
+    chmod +x "$STUB"
+}
+
+# --- session-cap-bb dispatcher.sh ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+run_dispatcher() {
+    local cid="cyc-$1"
+    local handoff="$WORK/tmp/loa-session-cap-bb.$cid"
+    mkdir -p "$handoff"
+    printf '{"action":"dispatch"}' > "$handoff/decider.json"
+    DISPATCHER_JSON="$handoff/dispatcher.json"
+    run env TMPDIR="$WORK/tmp" LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_ENTRY="$STUB" LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_REPO="fixture/repo" \
+        bash "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills/scheduled-cycle-template/contracts/session-cap-bb/dispatcher.sh" "$cid" sched-1 0 '[]'
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: Bridgebuilder exit 3 is completed-degraded — WARN names the voice, handoff degraded, exit 0" {
+    make_stub 3
+    run_dispatcher a
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: bridgebuilder completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5"* ]]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.bb_exit_code' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "3" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "true" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.incomplete_voices' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "openai/gpt-5.5" ]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: Bridgebuilder's run JSON still reaches stdout" {
+    make_stub 3
+    run_dispatcher b
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *'"mode":"multi-model"'* ]]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: exit 0 stays 0 with degraded false and no WARN" {
+    make_stub 0
+    run_dispatcher c
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"DEGRADED"* ]]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r 'has("incomplete_voices")' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+@test "dispatcher: any other non-zero exit is still a failure" {
+    make_stub 1
+    run_dispatcher d
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.bb_exit_code' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "1" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.degraded' "$DISPATCHER_JSON")" = "false" ]
+}
+
+# --- spiral-harness.sh _gate_bridgebuilder ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# run_gate <exit_code>: source the harness, point it at a fake skills tree holding the stub, run the gate
+run_gate() {
+    make_stub "$1"
+    mkdir -p "$WORK/fake/scripts" "$WORK/fake/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources" "$WORK/evidence"
+    cp "$STUB" "$WORK/fake/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh"
+    run bash -c '
+        cd "$1" || exit 99
+        source "$2/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh"
+        set +e
+        SCRIPT_DIR="$1/fake/scripts"
+        EVIDENCE_DIR="$1/evidence"
+        _record_action() { echo "RECORDED:$1:${10}"; }
+        _gate_bridgebuilder "https://github.com/fixture/repo/pull/7"
+        echo "GATE_RC=$?"
+    ' _ "$WORK" "$PROJECT_ROOT"
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: Bridgebuilder exit 3 logs one WARN naming the voice and the gate passes" {
+    run_gate 3
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: Bridgebuilder review iter 1 completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: openai/gpt-5.5"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"RECORDED:GATE_BRIDGEBUILDER:posted"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+    [ "$(grep -c 'DEGRADED' <<<"$output")" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: exit 0 logs no WARN" {
+    run_gate 0
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" != *"WARN: Bridgebuilder"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness gate: another non-zero exit is logged as not completed (non-blocking, as before)" {
+    run_gate 1
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: Bridgebuilder review iter 1 exited 1 (the review did not complete)"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"GATE_RC=0"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "spiral-harness: every entry.sh invocation goes through _bb_surface_exit (no bare || true)" {
+    local script="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/spiral-harness.sh"
+    local invocations surfaced
+    invocations=$(grep -c '"\$entry_script" --pr' "$script")
+    surfaced=$(grep -c '_bb_surface_exit "\$bb_rc"' "$script")
+    [ "$invocations" -ge 2 ]
+    [ "$invocations" -eq "$surfaced" ]
+}
+
+@test "entry.sh: the missing-dependency preflight exits 4, never the DEGRADED code 3" {
+    local entry="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh"
+    run grep -n '^  exit 3$' "$entry"
+    [ "$status" -ne 0 ]
+    run grep -c '^  exit 4$' "$entry"
+    [ "$output" = "1" ]
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# flatline-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1, SDD D-8.1, DEC-0146).
+#
+# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, flatline-orchestrator.sh plans its voices — and so its scorers, which are the
+# same voices cross-scoring — only on providers whose model entry says dispatch_group: local; each hosted voice is
+# refused by name at plan time (a hosted primary or secondary refuses the run, a hosted tertiary is not planned), the
+# advisor_strategy scorer route is refused, red-team mode is refused, and the default (hosted) is unchanged.
+# No model is called: call_model is a stub where a phase runs.
+# =============================================================================
+
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+
+setup() {
+    umask 022
+    REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+    source "$REPO/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh"
+    CONFIG_FILE="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/loa.config.yaml"
+    unset LOA_HEADLESS_MODE LOA_MODEL_CONFIG
+}
+
+_cfg() {  # <locality | absent> <primary> <secondary> [tertiary] [extra top-level yaml]
+    {
+        printf 'hounfour:\n'
+        [[ "$1" == absent ]] || printf '  locality: %s\n' "$1"
+        printf '  providers:\n    localbox:\n      type: openai_compat\n      endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"\n      models:\n'
+        printf '        qwen-local:\n          dispatch_group: local\n        qwen-local-b:\n          dispatch_group: local\n'
+        printf '  aliases:\n    lq: "localbox:qwen-local"\n    lqb: "localbox:qwen-local-b"\n'
+        printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  models:\n    primary: %s\n    secondary: %s\n' "$2" "$3"
+        [[ -z "${4:-}" ]] || printf '    tertiary: %s\n' "$4"
+        [[ -z "${5:-}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$5"
+    } > "$CONFIG_FILE"
+    _FLATLINE_LOCALITY_RESULT=""; _CACHED_TERTIARY_MODEL_SET=false; _CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER_SET=false
+}
+
+@test "FLL-1 hosted primary and secondary voices are refused by name; the run is refused" {
+    _cfg local_voices opus gpt-5.5
+    run --separate-stderr flatline_locality_gate
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop opus (anthropic)"* ]] || { echo "$stderr"; return 1; }
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5 (openai)"* ]]
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"refuses a hosted Flatline primary or secondary voice — nothing was dispatched"* ]]
+    # one hosted voice is enough to refuse
+    _cfg local_voices lq gpt-5.5
+    run --separate-stderr flatline_locality_gate
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5 (openai)"* ]]
+    [[ "$stderr" != *"refuses hosted hop lq "* ]]
+}
+
+@test "FLL-2 local primary and secondary are planned; a hosted tertiary is refused by name and not planned (2-model)" {
+    _cfg local_voices lq lqb gemini-2.5-pro
+    flatline_locality_gate 2> "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/err"
+    grep -qF "locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gemini-2.5-pro (google)" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/err"
+    [ "$(get_model_tertiary)" = "" ]
+    ! grep -q "refuses hosted hop lq" "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/err" || { echo "a local voice was refused"; return 1; }
+}
+
+@test "FLL-3 Phase 1 under local_voices dispatches only the local voices (no tertiary); the skeptic and review calls stay on them" {
+    _cfg local_voices lq lqb gemini-2.5-pro
+    TEMP_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TEMP_DIR"
+    CALLS="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/calls"; : > "$CALLS"
+    set_state() { :; }; log_trajectory() { :; }
+    validate_model() { return 0; }   # (name validation reads the repository config; not under test here)
+    call_model() { echo "$1 $2" >> "$CALLS"; printf '{"content":"{\\"improvements\\":[]}","cost_usd":0}\n'; }
+    log() { echo "$*" >&2; }
+    printf '# doc\n' > "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/doc.md"
+    run --separate-stderr run_phase1 "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/doc.md" prd "" 30 100
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$stderr" | tail -20; return 1; }
+    [ "$(cut -d' ' -f1 "$CALLS" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')" = "lq lqb " ]
+    [ "$(grep -c '' "$CALLS")" = "4" ]
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"refuses hosted hop gemini-2.5-pro (google)"* ]]

+@test "FLL-4 the advisor_strategy scorer route is refused under local_voices; the scorers stay on the pinned local voices" {

+    is_stage_routing_scorer_enabled
+    _CACHED_STAGE_ROUTING_SCORER_SET=false
+    flatline_locality_gate 2> "$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/err"

+@test "FLL-6 an unknown locality value is refused by name" {
+    _cfg local opus gpt-5.5
+    run --separate-stderr flatline_locality_gate

+    run --separate-stderr bash -c 'source "$1/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh"; CONFIG_FILE="$2"; main --doc "$3" --phase prd --dry-run --json' _ "$REPO" "$CONFIG_FILE" "$doc"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$output")" = "locality_refused" ]
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"refuses hosted hop opus (anthropic)"* ]]
+    _cfg local_voices lq lqb
+    run --separate-stderr bash -c 'source "$1/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh"; CONFIG_FILE="$2"; main --doc "$3" --phase prd --mode red-team --dry-run --json' _ "$REPO" "$CONFIG_FILE" "$doc"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"does not cover the red-team pipeline"* ]]
+    # the local plan passes the gate and reaches the dry run
+    run --separate-stderr bash -c 'source "$1/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh"; CONFIG_FILE="$2"; main --doc "$3" --phase prd --dry-run --json' _ "$REPO" "$CONFIG_FILE" "$doc"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$stderr" | tail; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$output")" = "dry_run" ]
+}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# session-cap-bb dispatcher.sh — phase 2 (dispatcher) for the post-reset
# bridgebuilder fan-out (bd-fanout-real-dispatch-9jv6 Tranche 1).
#
# On action:dispatch, fires the bridgebuilder-review headless entrypoint
# (resources/entry.sh — the same binary spiral-harness.sh already runs
# unattended) with --repo <owner/repo> and NO --pr, so BB self-discovers open
# PRs and dedups on its own incremental per-PR diff hashing. On action:noop it
# short-circuits (exit 0, nothing was in flight). This is the only mutating
# phase; a re-run under the same cycle_id re-invokes BB, whose per-PR hashing
# makes the review itself idempotent.
#
# Args: $1 cycle_id  $2 schedule_id  $3 phase_index  $4 prior_phases_json
set -euo pipefail

cycle_id="${1:?cycle_id required}"
schedule_id="${2:?schedule_id required}"

_here="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${_here}/../../../../.." && pwd)"
# The scheduler canonicalizes phase paths through the consumer's skills mount.
# Rebind a physical .loa root only when that consumer mounts these same skills.
if [[ "${REPO_ROOT##*/}" == ".loa" &&
      "${REPO_ROOT}/../.claude/skills" -ef "${REPO_ROOT}/.claude/skills" ]]; then
    REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${REPO_ROOT}/.." && pwd)"
fi
_sanitize() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_'; }
HANDOFF_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/loa-session-cap-bb.$(_sanitize "$cycle_id")"
mkdir -p "$HANDOFF_DIR"
DECIDER_FILE="${HANDOFF_DIR}/decider.json"

write_out() { printf '%s' "$1" | tee "${HANDOFF_DIR}/dispatcher.json"; }

action="noop"
if [[ -f "$DECIDER_FILE" ]] && jq empty "$DECIDER_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
    action="$(jq -r '.action // "noop"' "$DECIDER_FILE")"
fi

if [[ "$action" != "dispatch" ]]; then
    write_out "$(jq -nc --arg cid "$cycle_id" --arg sid "$schedule_id" \
        '{cycle_id:$cid, schedule_id:$sid, dispatched:false,
          reason:"nothing was in flight (decider noop)"}')"
    exit 0
fi

# Resolve owner/repo: explicit override wins, else derive from the git origin.
repo="${LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_REPO:-}"
if [[ -z "$repo" ]]; then
    url="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true)"
    repo="$(printf '%s' "$url" | sed -E 's#\.git$##; s#^.*[:/]([^/]+/[^/]+)$#\1#')"
fi
if [[ -z "$repo" ]]; then
    echo "dispatcher: could not resolve owner/repo (set LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_REPO or a git origin)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

BB_ENTRY="${LOA_SESSION_CAP_BB_ENTRY:-${_here}/../../../bridgebuilder-review/resources/entry.sh}"
if [[ ! -f "$BB_ENTRY" ]]; then
    echo "dispatcher: bridgebuilder entrypoint not found: $BB_ENTRY" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Fire BB with NO --pr: it self-discovers open PRs and dedups internally.
# BB's stdout (its run JSON) is kept in the handoff dir and replayed, so a DEGRADED run can name its voices.
BB_OUT="${HANDOFF_DIR}/bb-stdout.json"
rc=0
if [[ -x "$BB_ENTRY" ]]; then
    "$BB_ENTRY" --repo "$repo" >"$BB_OUT" || rc=$?
else
    bash "$BB_ENTRY" --repo "$repo" >"$BB_OUT" || rc=$?
fi
cat "$BB_OUT"

# cycle-129 D-7.7 (DEC-0150): exit 3 = the review COMPLETED with a DEGRADED consensus (bridgebuilder.exit_on_degraded;
# 0 restores the old exit). Not a failure: one WARN naming the incomplete voices, `degraded: true` in the handoff, exit 0.
degraded=false
voices=""
if [[ "$rc" -eq 3 ]]; then
    degraded=true
    voices=$(jq -r '[.verdicts[]?.voices.incomplete[]?] | unique | join(", ")' "$BB_OUT" 2>/dev/null) || voices=""
    echo "dispatcher: WARN: bridgebuilder completed DEGRADED (exit 3): incomplete voices: ${voices:-none named (degraded verdict quality)}" >&2
fi

write_out "$(jq -nc --arg cid "$cycle_id" --arg sid "$schedule_id" \
    --arg repo "$repo" --argjson ec "$rc" --argjson degraded "$degraded" --arg voices "$voices" \
    '{cycle_id:$cid, schedule_id:$sid, dispatched:true, repo:$repo,
      bb_exit_code:$ec, degraded:$degraded}
     + (if $degraded then {incomplete_voices: $voices} else {} end)')"
if [[ "$rc" -eq 3 ]]; then
    exit 0
fi
exit "$rc"

    # Budget check BEFORE spending a probe
    if ! _check_all_budgets; then
        exit 5
    fi

    case "$provider" in
        openai)    _probe_openai "$model_id" ;;
        google)    _probe_google "$model_id" ;;
        anthropic) _probe_anthropic "$model_id" ;;
        bedrock)   _probe_bedrock "$model_id" ;;
        *)
            if [[ "$provider" =~ $_CONFIGURED_NAME_RE ]] && _configured_providers | grep -qxF -- "$provider"; then
                # cycle-129 FR-7: a provider declared in the merged config.
                _probe_configured "$provider" "$model_id"
            else
                # Unknown provider passthrough (Flatline IMP-006 / SKP-004 #4)
                PROBE_STATE="UNKNOWN"; PROBE_CONFIDENCE="low"
                PROBE_REASON="unknown provider $provider"
                PROBE_HTTP="0"; PROBE_LATENCY_MS="0"
                PROBE_ERROR_CLASS="transient"
            fi
            ;;
    esac

    # Skip cost increment when the probe never made an HTTP call. The no-API-key
    # path returns from `_probe_<provider>` after only setting PROBE_ERROR_CLASS=auth
    # with PROBE_HTTP empty (cleared by _reset_probe_result). Real auth failures
    # carry PROBE_HTTP=401/403 and still consume budget. Without this guard, fork
    # PRs (no secrets) trip the cost hardstop after 5 unmade probes. (G-1, cycle-094)
    if [[ "$PROBE_ERROR_CLASS" != "auth" ]] || [[ -n "$PROBE_HTTP" && "$PROBE_HTTP" != "0" ]]; then
        PROBES_USED=$((PROBES_USED + 1))
        # Each probe charges a nominal 1 cent estimate (conservative). Real cost-tracking
        # would need token-accurate metering; this is a coarse cap gate.
        COST_CENTS_USED=$((COST_CENTS_USED + 1))
    fi

input.description: Read the bats s3 helper

content.content:
# shellcheck shell=bash
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-s3-helpers.bash — the whole-run harness shared by the cycle-129 Sprint 3 suites
# (adversarial-review-advisory.bats, -budget.bats, -locality.bats).
#
# main() is sourced and run with `invoke_dissenter` replaced by a stub keyed on the model (canned adapter envelopes + a
# valid single-voice verdict_quality sidecar, the shape the companion suite uses), a temp .loa.config.yaml, a temp
# catalog when a case needs one, no credentials (a keyless host) and the test's own ledgers. No model is ever called.
# =============================================================================

s3_setup() {  # <sprint prefix>
    umask 022
    S3_PREFIX="$1"
    SPRINT="${S3_PREFIX}-$$-${BATS_TEST_NUMBER:-0}"
    : "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:?BATS_TEST_TMPDIR not set — needs bats-core >= 1.4}"
    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
    export PROJECT_ROOT
    OUT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    [[ ! -e "$OUT_DIR" && ! -L "$OUT_DIR" ]] || { echo "setup: $OUT_DIR already stands" >&2; SPRINT=""; return 1; }
    export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$T/model-invoke.jsonl"
    export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$T/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$T" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$T/xdg-cache"
    export TMPDIR="$T/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_KEEP_WORKDIR LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_TAG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REAP_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_MODEL_CONFIG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_HOP_TIMEOUT \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
    eval "$_src"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
    local p v; local -a row
    for p in anthropic openai google; do read -ra row <<<"$(_adv_cred_aliases "$p")"; for v in "${row[@]}"; do unset "$v"; done; done
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR="$T/env"; mkdir -p "$LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR"
    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_PROBE=both
    CONFIG_FILE="$T/loa.config.yaml"
    printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n--- a/x.sh\n+++ b/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n' > "$T/diff.patch"
    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]
        local model="$3" sidecar="$5" b sev="ADVISORY"
        [[ "${6:-review}" == "audit" ]] && sev="MEDIUM"   # each gate's own vocabulary — no reject detour
        echo "$model" >> "$CALLS"
        b="${BEHAVIOUR[$model]:-ok}"
        case "$b" in
            ok)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" \
                  '{content: ({findings: [{id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:10",
                     description: ("from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.0123, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            two)   # one finding that matches the counted one (same file, overlapping lines, same category), one on another line,
                   # one on the same line in another category
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" '{content: ({findings: [
                    {id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:9-12", description: ("dup from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-002", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:40", description: ("new from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-003", severity: $s, category: "performance", anchor: "x.sh:10", description: ("other category from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.002, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            reject)   # a payload the normaliser cannot save (no severity)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;
            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
        esac
    }
    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        else
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        fi
    }
    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
}

s3_teardown() {
    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
    return 0
}

s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
    local rc=0
    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
}

s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
}

          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
    eval "$_src"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
    local p v; local -a row

    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi

    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]
        local model="$3" sidecar="$5" b sev="ADVISORY"
        [[ "${6:-review}" == "audit" ]] && sev="MEDIUM"   # each gate's own vocabulary — no reject detour
        echo "$model" >> "$CALLS"
        b="${BEHAVIOUR[$model]:-ok}"
        case "$b" in
            ok)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" \
                  '{content: ({findings: [{id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:10",
                     description: ("from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.0123, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            two)   # one finding that matches the counted one (same file, overlapping lines, same category), one on another line,
                   # one on the same line in another category
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" '{content: ({findings: [
                    {id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:9-12", description: ("dup from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-002", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:40", description: ("new from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-003", severity: $s, category: "performance", anchor: "x.sh:10", description: ("other category from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.002, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            reject)   # a payload the normaliser cannot save (no severity)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;
            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
        esac
    }
    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        else
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        fi
    }
    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
}

s3_teardown() {
    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
    return 0
}

s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
    local rc=0
    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
}

s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
}

+# shellcheck shell=bash
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/adversarial-review-s3-helpers.bash — the whole-run harness shared by the cycle-129 Sprint 3 suites
+# (adversarial-review-advisory.bats, -budget.bats, -locality.bats).
+#
+# main() is sourced and run with `invoke_dissenter` replaced by a stub keyed on the model (canned adapter envelopes + a
+# valid single-voice verdict_quality sidecar, the shape the companion suite uses), a temp .loa.config.yaml, a temp
+# catalog when a case needs one, no credentials (a keyless host) and the test's own ledgers. No model is ever called.
+# =============================================================================
+
+s3_setup() {  # <sprint prefix>
+    umask 022
+    S3_PREFIX="$1"
+    SPRINT="${S3_PREFIX}-$$-${BATS_TEST_NUMBER:-0}"
+    : "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:?BATS_TEST_TMPDIR not set — needs bats-core >= 1.4}"
+    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+    export PROJECT_ROOT
+    OUT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
+    [[ ! -e "$OUT_DIR" && ! -L "$OUT_DIR" ]] || { echo "setup: $OUT_DIR already stands" >&2; SPRINT=""; return 1; }
+    export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$T/model-invoke.jsonl"
+    export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$T/cost-ledger.jsonl"
+    export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$T" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$T/xdg-cache"
+    export TMPDIR="$T/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
+    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_KEEP_WORKDIR LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_TAG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE \
+          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REAP_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_MODEL_CONFIG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_HOP_TIMEOUT \
+          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
+          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
+    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
+    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
+    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
+    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
+    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
+    eval "$_src"
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
+    local p v; local -a row
+    for p in anthropic openai google; do read -ra row <<<"$(_adv_cred_aliases "$p")"; for v in "${row[@]}"; do unset "$v"; done; done
+    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR="$T/env"; mkdir -p "$LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR"
+    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi
+    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_PROBE=both
+    CONFIG_FILE="$T/loa.config.yaml"
+    printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n--- a/x.sh\n+++ b/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n' > "$T/diff.patch"
+    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
+    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
+    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
+    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
+    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]
+        local model="$3" sidecar="$5" b sev="ADVISORY"
+        [[ "${6:-review}" == "audit" ]] && sev="MEDIUM"   # each gate's own vocabulary — no reject detour
+        echo "$model" >> "$CALLS"

tool_use_result.stdout:
+    budget_cents: $2
+    timeout_seconds: 30
+    companion_voice: $3
+    fallback_chain: []
+${4:-}"
+}
+
+_big_diff() {  # a diff whose estimate is 1,000,500 input tokens (3,000,000 bytes / 3 + 500)
+    { printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n'; head -c $(( 3000000 - 25 )) /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'a'; } > "$T/diff.patch"
+    [ "$(wc -c < "$T/diff.patch")" -eq 3000000 ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-1 the primary is priced at its catalog rate (no fixed-rate fallback): 1,000,500 tokens × 2 + 2000 × 8 USD/Mtok = 201c" {
+    _big_diff
+    _cfg fixture-priced 150 false
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "budget_exceeded" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "201" ]
+    [ "$(jq -c '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | {role, alias, estimated_cents, pricing_source}]' <<<"$result")" = '[{"role":"primary","alias":"fixture-priced","estimated_cents":201,"pricing_source":"config"}]' ]
+    [ "$(jq -c '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | {role, alias, estimated_cents, pricing_source}]' <<<"$result")" = '[{"role":"primary","alias":"fixture-priced","estimated_cents":201,"pricing_source":"config"}]' ]
+    grep -qF "budget: estimate 201c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-priced 201c)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    ! grep -q "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log" || { echo "a catalog-priced primary fell back"; return 1; }
+    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-2 an alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok for that voice, said by name (1000c + 6c)" {
+    _big_diff
+    _cfg mystery-model-x 150 false
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.estimate_voices[0].pricing_source' <<<"$result")" = "fallback" ]
+    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (primary) — the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok applies to this voice" "$T/stderr.log"
+    [ "$(grep -c "no catalog price" "$T/stderr.log")" = "1" ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-3 a zero-priced entry estimates 0c and is said: a 0-cent budget admits it, where the fixed rate would refuse" {
+    _cfg fixture-zero 0 false
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (primary) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qF "budget: estimate 0c over 1 planned voice(s) (primary fixture-zero 0c)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qx "fixture-zero" "$CALLS"
+    # the same run priced at the fixed rate is refused (the regression this replaces: 2000 output tokens × 30 = 6c > 0)
+    _cfg mystery-model-x 0 false
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ]
+}
+
+@test "BUD-4 the gate sums every planned voice: primary + the companion's first hop + each advisory voice" {
+    _big_diff
+    _cfg fixture-priced 1 true "    advisory_voices: [fixture-zero, mystery-model-x]"
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "4" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.estimate_voices[] | "\(.role)=\(.alias)"] | join(" ")' <<<"$result")" = "primary=fixture-priced companion=claude-headless advisory=fixture-zero advisory=mystery-model-x" ]
+    # the companion's price is the catalog's (whatever it is today): recompute it from the same CLI
+    local row ci co comp
+    row=$(PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters" python3 -W ignore::RuntimeWarning -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias claude-headless --config "$CONFIG_FILE")
+    ci=$(sed -n 's/.* input_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row"); co=$(sed -n 's/.* output_per_mtok=\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$row")
+    [[ "$ci" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$co" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
+    comp=$(( 1000500 * ci / 10000000000 + 2000 * co / 10000000000 ))
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[1].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$comp" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[2].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "0" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimate_voices[3].estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "1006" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" = "$(( 201 + comp + 0 + 1006 ))" ]
+    [ "$(jq '[.metadata.estimate_voices[].estimated_cents] | add' <<<"$result")" = "$(jq '.metadata.estimated_cents' <<<"$result")" ]
+    grep -qF "budget: fixture-zero (advisory) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for mystery-model-x (advisory)" "$T/stderr.log"
+}
+
+@test "BUD-5 a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) is used as given and said" {
+    _cfg fixture-stale 1000 false
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    grep -qF "budget: fixture-stale (primary) has a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) — used as given" "$T/stderr.log"
+}
+
+@test "BUD-6 with no price CLI answer at all every voice falls back and is said (the gate never prices from nothing)" {
+    _cfg fixture-priced 1000 false
+    # a PYTHONPATH that cannot import the package: the CLI fails, every planned voice is unknown
+    local real patched
+    real="$(declare -f _adv_budget_estimate)"
+    patched="${real/PYTHONPATH=\"\$PROJECT_ROOT\/.claude\/adapters\"/PYTHONPATH=/nonexistent}"
+    [ "$patched" != "$real" ]   # (the seam was found: the CLI really cannot be imported in this run)
+    eval "$patched"
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ]
+    grep -qF "budget: no catalog price for fixture-priced (primary)" "$T/stderr.log"

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/adversarial-review-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1 … AC-8.3, SDD D-8.0 … D-8.2,
+# DEC-0146).
+#
+# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, adversarial-review.sh plans only hops whose provider has dispatch_group: local in
+# the merged config (catalog + the project's hounfour.providers) and refuses every hosted hop of its inventory at plan time
+# by name — primary chain, companion chain, advisory voices, the KF-004 repair chain (tiny, claude-headless, any pin; the
+# chain is the answering voice). With one local family the audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW, the gate and verdict-derive
+# treat the envelope as today, and the output says so. The default (hosted) is unchanged. Mock mode: the harness stub.
+# =============================================================================
+
+load adversarial-review-s3-helpers
+
+setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3loc; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
+teardown() { s3_teardown; }
+
+# one hosted provider (openai, the catalog's) and one local provider (localbox, declared here)
+_cfg() {  # <locality value | absent> [extra code_review / security_audit lines]
+    local loc=""; [[ "$1" == absent ]] || loc="  locality: $1"
+    s3_config "hounfour:
+$loc
+  providers:
+    localbox:
+      type: openai_compat
+      endpoint: \"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1\"
+      models:
+        qwen-local:
+          dispatch_group: local
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
+        qwen-local-b:
+          dispatch_group: local
+          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
+        qwen-local-c:
+          dispatch_group: local
+        qwen-leaky:
+          dispatch_group: local
+          fallback_chain: [\"openai:gpt-5.5\"]
+  aliases:
+    lq: \"localbox:qwen-local\"
+    lqb: \"localbox:qwen-local-b\"
+    lqc: \"localbox:qwen-local-c\"
+flatline_protocol:
+  code_review:
+    enabled: true
+    model: gpt-5.5
+    budget_cents: 500
+    timeout_seconds: 30
+    fallback_chain: [lq]
+${2:-}
+  security_audit:
+    enabled: true
+    model: gpt-5.5
+    budget_cents: 500
+    timeout_seconds: 30
+    fallback_chain: [lq]
+${3:-}"
+}
+
+_hosted_in() {  # <file of hop names, one per line> → the hosted ones, as hop-locality.py classifies them against this config
+    local hops; hops=$(sed 's/^repair://' "$1" | sort -u | grep -v '^$' || true)
+    [[ -n "$hops" ]] || return 0
+    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
+    python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
+        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- $hops | awk -F'\t' '$3 != "local" { print $1 }'
+}
+
+@test "LOC-1 one hosted and one local provider: only the local hop is planned and every hosted hop is refused by name" {
+    _cfg local_voices
+    result=$(s3_run review)
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
+    # the dispatched hops: the local one only
+    [ "$(sort -u "$CALLS" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "lq " ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.final_model' "$env")" = "lq" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.model_attempts | join(",")' "$env")" = "lq:reviewed" ]
+    # each refusal named: the hosted primary, the companion's default hop, the repair chain's two hosted hops
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5 (openai)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop claude-headless (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop tiny (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
+    # the companion was not planned: its chain had no local hop — never rerouted
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.planned' "$env")" = "false" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.companion_voice.reason' "$env")" = "locality_refused" ]
+    # the envelope names the posture and each refusal with its role
+    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.locality.mode' "$env")" = "local_voices" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '[.metadata.locality.refused[] | "\(.role):\(.alias):\(.provider)"] | sort | join(" ")' "$env")" = \
+      "companion:claude-headless:anthropic primary:gpt-5.5:openai repair:claude-headless:anthropic repair:tiny:anthropic" ]
+    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "1" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-2 the repair chain is pinned to the answering local voice: no tiny, no claude-headless, no pin — even with an Anthropic key" {
+    _cfg local_voices
+    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key"   # (tiny would lead the hosted chain with a key present)
+    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL="tiny claude-headless"
+    load_adversarial_config review
+    [ "$CONF_LOCALITY" = "local_voices" ]
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "lq" ]
+    [ "$(_repair_chain_base lq)" = "lq" ]
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain gpt-5.5)" = "" ]   # (a hosted answering voice gets no repair hop at all)
+    # and under hosted the same host walks tiny first (the switch is what pins it)
+    _cfg hosted
+    load_adversarial_config review
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "tiny claude-headless" ]   # (the operator pin is the whole chain under hosted)
+    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL
+    [ "$(_repair_model_chain lq)" = "tiny claude-headless lq" ]
+}
+
+@test "LOC-3 redaction-style: in a whole run with a rejected payload, an Anthropic key and the CLIs present, no hosted alias is ever dispatched" {
+    _cfg local_voices "    advisory_voices: [lqc, gpt-5.5-pro]
+    companion_chain:
+      anthropic: [opus, lqb]"
+    export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key" OPENAI_API_KEY="fixture-not-a-key"
+    _repair_finding_via_model() { echo "repair:$4" >> "$CALLS"; return 1; }
+    BEHAVIOUR[lq]=reject
+    s3_run review >/dev/null
+    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
+    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
+    [ -s "$CALLS" ]
+    grep -qx "repair:lq" "$CALLS"   # (the repair loop ran — pinned to the answering voice)
+    [ "$(_hosted_in "$CALLS")" = "" ] || { echo "hosted hops dispatched:"; _hosted_in "$CALLS"; return 1; }
+    # no hosted name in any planned hop the envelope records
+    local planned
+    planned=$(jq -r '[.metadata.model_attempts[], (.metadata.companion_voice.chain // [])[], (.advisory_voices // [] | map(select(.status != "refused")) | .[].alias)] | .[] | sub(":[a-z_]+$"; "")' "$env")
+    printf '%s\n' "$planned" > "$T/planned"
+    [ "$(_hosted_in "$T/planned")" = "" ] || { echo "hosted hops planned:"; _hosted_in "$T/planned"; return 1; }

content.text:
Review written to `/workspace/review.md`. Verdict: **CHANGES_REQUIRED**.

**What I checked.** I read the whole diff (adapter Python, endpoint policy, the three shell scripts, the Bridgebuilder TypeScript and its dist build, docs, and the new bats and pytest suites), verified every new helper the shell scripts call exists in the head files, confirmed the dist manifest hashes match the TypeScript sources, confirmed the regenerated validator hash matches the Python source, and ran the head endpoint validator and the hop-locality classifier directly against the PR's own case tables plus the stock Bedrock template endpoint. Those all behave as the tests expect, so the core D-7.2 opt-in rule and the local-voices classifier are sound.

**Findings that block merge.**

- **Configured hosted providers can never be probed.** The new `model-health-probe.sh --provider <name>` path validates the URL against the built-in host allowlist twice, so any configured https provider not in that list (the Azure example in the config file, for one) is refused with ENDPOINT-NOT-ALLOWED. The cheval loader admits the same endpoint. The "one endpoint rule" claim does not hold for the probe.
- **The probe's local_voices refusal does not exist.** Four documents say the health probe refuses hosted probes under `local_voices`. The script never reads the key.
- **Wrong exit-code contract for hop-locality.py.** The scripts reference says exit 1 means hosted, but the script always exits 0 and reports locality in a TSV column. A caller following the doc would treat every hop as local.
- **Three classifiers disagree on provider-level `dispatch_group`.** The dissent, Flatline and Bridgebuilder planners treat a provider-level `dispatch_group: local` as local. The cheval MODELINV writer and the OpenAI adapter's transport policy only look at the model entry, so such a hop is planned local but recorded hosted and dispatched without the no-proxy, no-redirect rules.
- **Overstated trust claim in the Bridgebuilder skill doc.** Only a handful of provider keys come from the trusted config. Cheval still reads the head checkout's provider endpoints, so a PR head can still redirect a hosted provider's credential to any public https host.

Each finding carries the head file and line in `review.md`. The remaining work is the probe's allowlist handling and locality gate, aligning the three dispatch-group rules, and correcting the three doc statements.
